title: AMBROSIA BEETLE SURFACE STERILIZATION
author: M. Elizabeth Moore
materials: Stage beetles in container while preparing for wash.
The tea strainer can comfortably hold 50-100 beetles.

steps.title: Prepare sterilization solutions
steps.instruction: Label separate beakers and fill them with the following solutions: 75 % ethanol, 2 % bleach, 0.01 % Tween (e.g., Tween‑20), and prepare two additional beakers containing deionized water (diH₂O).

steps.title: Transfer beetles into Falcon tube
steps.instruction: Place a funnel onto a sterile 15 mL (or appropriate size) Falcon tube and gently pour the ambrosia beetles through the funnel, tapping the funnel as needed to keep beetles from escaping.

steps.title: Cover tube with tea strainer
steps.instruction: Remove the funnel and immediately cover the open end of the Falcon tube with one side of a sterile tea strainer, ensuring a snug fit.

steps.title: Move beetles into strainer
steps.instruction: Flip the Falcon tube so the covered end remains down, keep the strainer in place, and tap the tube gently to dislodge the beetles into the strainer.

steps.title: Seal strainer gaps
steps.instruction: Close the tea strainer and secure any openings with a small clip so that beetles cannot escape.

steps.title: Immerse beetles in sterilization solutions
steps.instruction: Repeatedly dunk the tea strainer (still holding the beetles) into each prepared beaker for approximately ten seconds per beaker, moving from ethanol to bleach to Tween solution and finally through the two deionized‑water rinses.

substeps.instruction: Dunk in first deionized‑water beaker for ~10 s.
Dunk in second deionized‑water beaker for ~10 s.

steps.title: Dry strainer
steps.instruction: Place the tea strainer on a clean paper towel and gently dab to remove excess liquid.

steps.title: Transfer beetles to sterile dish
steps.instruction: Dump the beetles from the strainer onto a sterile Petri dish containing sterile filter paper and allow them to air‑dry.

steps.title: Remove residual beetles safely
steps.instruction: Using soft forceps, carefully pull any beetles that remain stuck in the strainer, taking care not to crush them; avoid closing the strainer fully while water droplets are present to prevent beetles from being trapped.
